density.description: Multiply instance/ribbon density; survivors retain their original placement and variation when upstream points are unchanged.

outputs.description: Optional nonempty list of base output filenames to export for this level. Defaults to all outputs.

overrides.description: Node-name to parameter-patch map, applied after global reductions. Existing op cannot change; all resulting nodes validate.

screen_height.description: Optional normalized screen-height threshold recorded in the manifest for engine integration; no runtime switching is implemented.

topology.description: Multiply tube sides, leaf/card subdivisions and ellipsoid rings/sides, rounding down to valid minima. Leaves/cards keep their deformation controls; crossed plane count is unchanged.

tube_stride.description: Multiply tube/ribbon stride, clamped at 512; retain the original growth paths and both tube endpoints.
